input.command: ls graphify-out | head; graphify query "files that use QueryCell from apps/web/lib/QueryCell.tsx" 2>&1 | head -40

content.text:
Five files use `QueryCell` from `apps/web/lib/QueryCell.tsx`. Each imports it through `@lib/QueryCell` or a relative path. I found them by searching the repo for the name and checking each import.

- `apps/web/modules/apps/installed/[category]/installed-category-view.tsx` imports it from `@lib/QueryCell` and renders `<QueryCell>`.
- `apps/web/components/apps/CalendarListContainer.tsx` imports it from `@lib/QueryCell` and renders `<QueryCell>`.
- `apps/web/components/apps/installation/EventTypeConferencingAppSettings.tsx` imports it from `@lib/QueryCell` and renders `<QueryCell>`.
- `apps/web/components/dialog/EditLocationDialog.tsx` imports it from `../../lib/QueryCell` and renders `<QueryCell>`.
- `apps/web/components/dialog/__tests__/EditLocationDialog.test.tsx` is the test file. It mocks `../../../lib/QueryCell` with `vi.mock` and sets the `QueryCell` mock's implementation.

`packages/platform/atoms/selected-calendars/wrappers/SelectedCalendarsSettingsPlatformWrapper.tsx` also calls a `QueryCell`, but a different one. It imports it from `@calcom/trpc/components/QueryCell`, which is a separate copy at `packages/trpc/components/QueryCell.tsx`. I left it out of the list.

</files>
